name: revision-request
description: Review revision requests before modifying your files, and choose whether to accept them.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Proposals can be viewed; accepting changes requires a trusted workspace.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No revision request in this workspace.
Ask your agent to create a .rr file with the original text and proposed text. Requests appear here automatically.
[Open a request](command:revisionRequest.openRequest)

enumDescriptions: Automatically open the preview whenever an opened .rr source is selected. Open RR as JSON keeps the current source viewing session editable.
Automatically open the preview only on the first activation of each opened .rr document.
Open .rr files as JSON. Use Open Preview or the Requests sidebar to review them.
revisionRequest.previewMode.description: Choose when .rr files open their visual preview. Closing a preview keeps the revealed JSON source open until you select another document.

revisionRequest.previewOnOpen.description: Open the comparison preview automatically when you open a .rr file. Turn off to open JSON first. Open RR as JSON always opens the source.
revisionRequest.previewOnOpen.deprecationMessage: Use Revision Request: Preview Mode instead. An explicitly configured legacy value is honored only when Preview Mode is not explicitly set: true means once, false means manual.

enumDescriptions: Removed and added lines in one column.
Original and proposed text in separate columns.
revisionRequest.defaultLayout.description: Initial layout for new previews. Each preview keeps its restored or toggled layout until it is closed.

enumDescriptions: Tab instead of inserting a tab while editing.
Shift+Tab instead of moving focus while editing.
revisionRequest.acceptShortcut.description: Shortcut to accept the currently edited pending block, applying its current text to the original. Only active inside the proposal editor.

revisionRequest.unchangedOpacity.description: Opacity of unchanged code in the right-hand RR preview, as a percentage. 0 hides it and 100 shows it fully. Pending changes and the original on the left stay fully visible.

revisionRequest.autoDeleteCompleted.description: Delete completed .rr requests when no confirmation is shown. Turn off to keep them. Completing the last pending change asks first unless Skip Completed Delete Confirmation is enabled. Uses the system trash when available.

revisionRequest.skipCompletedDeleteConfi.description: Do not ask whether to delete the .rr file when the last pending change is accepted or ignored, individually or all at once. Use Auto Delete Completed to choose deletion or preservation. Turn off to ask again.

revisionRequest.highlightChangedLines.description: Show a background tint across pending changed lines. Turn off to keep only the stronger highlights on changed text.

revisionRequest.showOnlyChangedText.description: Hide unchanged text within pending changed lines, keeping its space for alignment. Only the changed text remains visible. Other context lines are unaffected.

revisionRequest.mcp.allowAgentDecisions.description: Allow AI agents connected through Revision Request MCP to Accept, Ignore, and Undo changes, including bulk actions. Disabled by default. Only User Settings can enable this; workspace settings cannot. Human preview buttons are unaffected.
